create_gemini_client: create a GeminiCloudCodeClient instance that acts as an OpenAI-compatible facade for Google Cloud Code Assist
build_gemini_request: build a Gemini request body from OpenAI-shaped messages, tools, and generation config parameters
wrap_code_assist_request: wrap a Gemini request body inside the Code Assist envelope with project, model, and user_prompt_id
translate_gemini_response: translate a Gemini API response into an OpenAI-shaped chat.completion response object
translate_stream_event: translate a Gemini SSE stream event into OpenAI-shaped streaming chunk objects
